JAP_tokyo_express = {

	# The IJN (Combined Fleet Headquarters) is established by the
	# JAP_tokyo_express_operations focus itself (common/national_focus/japan.txt);
	# the old JAP_establish_ijn decision was retired 2026-07-24 (user ruling:
	# the focus is the only production path, debug_jr_establish_ijn the only other one).

	# The per-region "Tokyo Express" run decisions live in the auto-generated
	# JAP_tokyo_express_runs.txt (one state_target + map_only decision per adopted sea
	# region, icon on the region's anchor state; _modtools/Generate-TokyoExpressRegions.py).
	# Their shared launch body is JAP_te_launch_run_effect in JAP_scripted_effects.txt.

	# Unclickable status card shown while NO run is active; the per-region running
	# cards are generated alongside the run decisions.
	JAP_te_status_idle = {
		icon = generic_naval

		visible = {
			original_tag = JAP
			IJN = { is_subject_of = ROOT }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = JAP_te_active }
		}

		available = {
			hidden_trigger = { always = no }
		}

		cost = 0

		fire_only_once = no

		complete_effect = {
		}
	}

	# Self-restarting timer mission, modelled directly on JAP_southern_development_fund_mission
	# (common/decisions/JAP.txt, category JAP_southern_expansion): ticks every 7 days, counts
	# down JAP_te_rounds, and re-activates itself while rounds remain and IJN still has destroyers.
	JAP_te_tick_mission = {
		icon = generic_naval

		allowed = {
			always = no
		}

		available = {
			always = no
		}

		activation = {
			always = no
		}

		days_mission_timeout = 7
		is_good = yes
		fire_only_once = no

		timeout_effect = {
			subtract_from_variable = { JAP_te_rounds = 1 }
			# Weekly sampling: the buff follows last week's surviving destroyer count,
			# so ships sunk mid-week only lower it on this tick. The attachment sweep
			# follows the same last-week logic: coasts Japan (re)took join the run now,
			# coasts lost stop being resupplied now (the stockpile the captor took kept
			# feeding them until this tick - deliberate, user ruling 2026-07-15).
			JAP_te_sample_band_effect = yes
			JAP_te_refresh_supply_effect = yes
			JAP_te_push_supply_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { JAP_te_rounds > 0 }
					check_variable = { JAP_te_band > 0 }
				}
				activate_mission = JAP_te_tick_mission
			}
			else = {
				# Rounds exhausted, or the whole flotilla was sunk (band = 0 -> the run failed).
				IJN = {
					transfer_navy = { target = JAP }
				}
				clr_country_flag = JAP_te_active
				JAP_te_remove_supply_effect = yes
			}
		}

		complete_effect = {
		}
	}
}
